methodology: Verse-by-verse preliminary screening of Qur'an 6:141–150 against accessible translations and selected earlier textual passages. Earlier-text locators remain unverified/nonpublic pending original-language, critical edition, textual history, provenance and dating checks.

entries.summary: Gardens, produce, harvest dues and avoiding excess

staged_candidates.comparison: Both regulate fruit cultivation and sacred obligation; Leviticus specifies a multi-year fruit restriction, not a harvest-day due.

entries.caveat: Research lead checked only at accessible translation level; no critical Hebrew edition, manuscript witness or textual-dependence verification. Not public.
